title: Center-align medications page layout

requirements.text: Center-align the medications page content horizontally within the viewport

quotes: can you move medications page in centre

acceptanceCriteria: The medications page content is horizontally centered on the screen
The layout maintains responsiveness across different screen sizes
The centering works consistently with the existing Design B theme styling

constraints: Do not modify the existing Design B theme system or color palette
Preserve the current DesignBAppShell layout structure
nonGoals: Creating a new medications page if one doesn't exist
Changing the functionality or data of the medications feature
Modifying the navigation or routing structure
